title: Peformance Team // Recap
summary: Performance fell across accounts: weekly spend was down 8%, the Blood Flow budget was cut 40% and cost per new visitor rose 35% as Black Friday competition grew. The Black Friday campaign has about 120 ad sets and stronger overall ROAS, so budgets rise at midnight into Friday and drop sharply Monday night. Hascap moves to Shopify but cannot launch until its product page, copy and angles are ready.
points: About 90% of the creative mix is video, and Meta is serving top-of-funnel videos to warmer audiences, lowering the share of new visitors
Angle-level reads are unreliable while every campaign follows the same account-wide decline
Existing presales look dated and the move to product pages may have cut conversion
Black Friday campaigns show a 30 to 40% gap between new-customer and overall ROAS as old subscribers return
AppLovin looks promising with little competition; 60-second cuts of cholesterol, blood pressure, brain and neuro winners
Hascap ad account, pixel and payment are ready; product page, development and copy are not
Avia is weak, with thyroid videos taking most spend and three versions of a strong concept rejected
Cortisol seen as a broad source problem Avia can compete on
decisions: Focus creative on Black Friday offers through Friday, then scale budgets on ROAS and cut them Monday night
Keep unaware ads below half of new videos and lead with problem-aware concepts for Q1
Build new listicles, advertorials and presale formats for Q1
Test several angles on AppLovin through the general product page first, then give winners their own campaigns
Use gifting messaging until delivery before Christmas is no longer possible
Standardise ad naming with angle, product, awareness, concept, sub-angle, ICP, video, hook, format, strategist and editor

tasksImported.title: Launch the Hascap campaigns on Shopify once the product page and creatives are ready

Develop new listicle, advertorial and presale formats for Q1
Make gifting-angle ads that stress delivery before Christmas
